name: Ghirardelli Chocolate
about: Ghirardelli is a famous American chocolate brand founded in San Francisco in 1852. Its shops and square have long been a popular stop for visitors.
tip: Buy a box near the end of your trip, since chocolate can melt in warm weather.

name: Sourdough Bread
about: San Francisco is known for its tangy sourdough bread, made with a natural starter. Boudin Bakery has been baking it in the city for generations.
tip: Buy it just before you leave, since fresh sourdough goes stale within a few days.
